faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CEPI Data Analyst recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting applications for the CEPI Data Analyst recruitment is 28th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Data Analyst post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's Degree in Data Analysis/Statistics/Computer Science/IT with at least 60% marks or a Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science/MCA/Engineering/Data Science/Statistics with at least 50% marks.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Data Analyst position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Data Analyst position is 45 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Data Analyst role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 54,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the CEPI Data Analyst job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply by sending their resume and required documents via email to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Data Analyst post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Data Analyst post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the CEPI Data Analyst recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Data Analyst is on a contractual basis.
